items.heading: After Inter in the Mpc
items.text: After Inter in the MPC group, the main routes are B.Tech through entrance exams, BSc, BCA, architecture, defence and integrated science programmes. Pick by interest, entrance rank, cost and the skill you can build beside the degree.
